{{Quote|This guy, a trader out near Naboo, he picked up a distress signal from someone who said she was stranded on&hellip;uh, Baarstal. Yes, that's it! She was stranded on Baarstal, and she was carrying on about how her M38 droid went haywire and started damaging the ship.|[[Raalo]]|<ref name="SG" />}}
'''Baarstal''' was an [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomical]] object<ref name="SG" /> that was located within the [[Baarstal system/Legends|Baarstal system]]<ref name="Fry" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point shortly before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a small incident occurred near Baarstal. Onboard the [[Starship/Legends|star ship]] of a certain woman, an [[M38-series explorer droid|M38 droid]] went haywire and began damaging the vessel. Before she realized what was happening, the droid had wrecked the engines and several other systems before leaving the ship and disappearing into the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]. Later, a trader near [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] picked up a distress signal from Baarstal.<ref name="SG" />
